Section 1 · The federated demo arc at a glance

The demo runs against three L1 HoldCos loaded into AbarVa under one Lakeshore holding_group_id. Each HoldCo's CXO bench onboards via the CXO Intel Loader; five Moves run in parallel; the L0 sponsor watches it all from Tower's Federated tab.

Entry — Setup / Admin loader

Every HoldCo CXO uploads their bundle (CIO · CFO · COO · CHRO · GC). Loaded data scoped to that HoldCo's tenant; aggregates roll up to L0 only.

5 bundles per HoldCo · 15 total loads
Middle — five Moves in flight

Move 0 de-risks Kyriba (HoldCo-scoped). Move 1 adds AI on top. Move 2-4 are L0-led cross-HoldCo optimization tracks. Source events spawn from Move architecture phases when procurement is in scope.

5 Moves · 4-6 Source spawns
L0 view — Tower Federated tab

Sponsor sees portfolio rollups, cross-HoldCo opportunities surfaced this week, federated savings ledger (projected vs realized), risk concentration trend, CXO performance dashboards.

Atlas-fronted

Substrate posture (demo shortcut)

Per the locked tenancy decision: demo uses holding_group_id column on existing tenants table with cross-tenant aggregate-read RLS for users with L0 sponsor role. Proper parent-child tenant hierarchy is post-demo substrate work. Source policy: src/lib/auth/source-access-policy.ts extended to honor holding_group_id for L0 aggregate reads.

Section 3 · CXO Intel Loader — the gate into the demo

Each HoldCo onboards by having its CXO bench (or admin acting on their behalf) load five bundles. Wave 1 ships CIO + CFO loaders first; Wave 2 ships COO + CHRO + GC. Every loader has the same shape: schema · upload · parse · validate · approve · land in substrate.

CIO bundle Wave 1
  • Application inventory (per app: name, vendor, criticality, owner, annual cost, renewal date)
  • Cloud/on-prem footprint (Azure/AWS/GCP/on-prem split with annual run cost)
  • Major vendor contracts > $250K annual (vendor, category, $, term, renewal, exit clause)
  • AI roadmap (active POCs, planned use cases, governance state)
  • IT spend by category (run / grow / transform with %)
  • Risk register (cyber, compliance, modernization debt)
  • IT org chart (FTE, contractor, offshore mix)

Approval routing: HoldCo CIO · data steward acks load

CFO bundle Wave 1
  • Finance system inventory (ERP, treasury, AP/AR, EPM)
  • Banking relationships (per bank: services, fee structure, H2H readiness, annual fees)
  • Audit + advisory firm engagements (firm, scope, annual $, renewal)
  • Insurance brokers + carriers (line, broker, premium, renewal)
  • Close cycle metrics (days, variance trend)
  • IT spend ratios (% of revenue, $ per FTE)
  • Tax advisor + engagements

Approval routing: HoldCo CFO · controller acks load

COO bundle Wave 2
  • Operations stack (ERP, MES, supply chain, CRM per PortCo)
  • Workforce comp by function
  • Outsourced vs insourced split
  • Operating KPIs (cycle times, throughput, quality)
  • Vendor + 3PL relationships

Approval routing: HoldCo COO · ops PMO acks

CHRO bundle Wave 2
  • HCM stack (Workday, ADP, SuccessFactors)
  • Benefits stack + broker
  • L&D stack
  • Talent acquisition stack (ATS, sourcing tools)
  • Workforce demographics (FTE, contractor, geography, function)

Approval routing: HoldCo CHRO · people ops acks

GC / CCO bundle Wave 2
  • Contract index (vendor, type, $, term, renewal, exit)
  • Regulatory inventory (jurisdictions, frameworks, audit schedule)
  • Litigation pipeline (status, exposure)
  • Entity registry (legal structure, board composition)
  • D&O / E&O / cyber insurance program

Approval routing: HoldCo GC · legal ops acks

The five bundles in holding_group view

Once all 15 bundles (5 CXO × 3 HoldCos) land, AbarVa runs cross-HoldCo joins: vendor overlap detection, contract renewal calendar (federated), AI capability marketplace, risk concentration. These power Tower's "Federated" tab and Move 2-4.

L0 visibility: aggregates only · drill-down requires HoldCo grant

Section 4 · Move 0 — Kyriba De-Risk · the canonical platform rollout pattern

Scope: per HoldCo where a platform rollout (Kyriba, Workday, NetSuite, Salesforce) is in flight. Six gates. Reusable pattern. This is the demo's load-bearing Move — it goes first because Kyriba is real at Morgan Street and Lakefront's mature deployment is the case-study evidence.

Move 0 — Kyriba De-Risk (per HoldCo)

Primary scope: Morgan Street · reference: Lakefront (mature) · spans Phase 0 through Phase 5

→

The 6 gates Sentinel diagnoses + remediates

G1
Bank connectivity gap

Morgan Street has 14 banks, only 4 H2H-ready. Remediation: pre-rollout banking consolidation RFP (spawns Source event L-S01). Target: 6 strategic banks, all H2H. Owner: Group Treasurer. Reference benchmark: finserv file 08.

G2
ERP feed quality

Morgan Street's NetSuite → Kyriba feed has 0.4% daily variance. Remediation: feed audit per source system, mapping cleanup, automated reconciliation. Owner: Controller. Acceptance: variance < 0.05% sustained 30 days.

G3
Entity hierarchy + IC mapping

IC mapping for 2 PortCos still under reconciliation. Remediation: canonical entity registry load from corporate secretary + tax data; IC matrix rebuild; one-shot reload to Kyriba. Owner: Controller + Tax. Acceptance: IC eliminations auto-resolve at month-end.

G4
Historical position reconstruction

<90 days clean position data; predictive forecasting blocked. Remediation: 24-month bank statement reconstruction; Silver-layer normalized by entity-currency-day; backfilled forecast model training. Owner: Treasury Analytics. Acceptance: 18+ months continuous clean data available for model training.

G5
User adoption

32 of 48 expected users logging in weekly. Remediation: role-based dashboards per persona, 30-day Excel-elimination sprint with named KPIs, weekly office hours. Owner: Treasury PM + Change Lead. Acceptance: 90% weekly active sustained 60 days.

G6
IC auto-reconciliation

Month-end IC posting manual (4-day cycle). Remediation: transformer-based matching across PortCo books (Move 1 capability shipped early to support Move 0). Owner: Controller. Acceptance: IC posting same-day, T+1 close at HoldCo level.

Move 0 → Source event spawn

If G1 remediation requires bank consolidation (Morgan Street's case), Move 0 Architecture phase emits a Source event with 5 pre-filled facts:

L-S01 · Banking consolidation RFP Pre-fill: 14 incumbents Target: 6 strategic Rubric: H2H + fees + treasury depth + FX + geography Owner: Treasurer + Procurement

Section 5 · Move 1 — AI on top of Kyriba

Scope: per HoldCo, post-Move 0 (all 6 gates green or in remediation). Four AI capabilities. Lakefront is the live reference (case-study evidence); Morgan Street is the rollout target.

Move 1 — AI on top of Kyriba (per HoldCo)

Prerequisite: Move 0 G1-G4 minimum green · G5-G6 in flight acceptable
Capability 1 · 12-week forward cash forecast

Bronze: bank transactions + Kyriba positions. Silver: normalized by entity-currency-day. Gold: predicted position per entity per currency, daily refresh, with confidence bands.

Approval: Group Treasurer + CFO · sign-off on model accuracy threshold

Capability 2 · Payment anomaly + BEC fraud detection

Real-time scoring on outgoing wires > $50K. Human-in-loop block on red signals. Lakefront's deployed model reduced false-positive rate to <2% after 6mo tuning.

Approval: Treasurer + CISO · payment threshold policy + escalation matrix

Capability 3 · Covenant headroom forecasting

Predicts debt covenant breach 8 weeks out. Treasurer gets advance warning; CFO + Audit Cmte see trend at monthly close. Tied to specific covenant clauses in loaded contracts.

Approval: CFO + Audit Cmte chair · covenant-specific thresholds

Capability 4 · Intercompany auto-reconciliation

Transformer-based matching across PortCo books → IC eliminations posted same-day, not month-end. Compresses HoldCo close by 4 days.

Approval: Controller + Tax · matching rule confidence threshold

Section 7 · Move 3 — Federated IT Strategy + AI Use Case Marketplace

Scope: L0 cross-HoldCo. Surfaces what one HoldCo built that another can deploy. Coordinates modernization waves. Powered by CIO bundles + AI roadmap data.

Move 3 — Federated IT Strategy

L0 Operating Partner — Technology · HoldCo CIOs consulted

What Move 3 produces

  • AI capability marketplace — Lakefront's 3 production AI workloads cataloged; Morgan Street + Roosevelt browse, reuse, fork. Reduces duplicate POCs across HoldCos.
  • Modernization wave coordinator — three HoldCos all moving Workday and Snowflake. Coordinated SI selection + change methodology · estimated 20-30% cost reduction.
  • Cloud architecture standards — Lakefront's mature Azure landing zone shared; Morgan Street + Roosevelt fork-and-customize.
  • Federated AI governance — single AI ethics + risk framework adopted across HoldCos.
  • Quarterly federated IT operating review — Marcus Rhee (L0 OP-Tech) + 3 HoldCo CIOs · benchmarks · risk · capability sharing.

Section 8 · Move 4 — Federated Risk + Governance

Scope: L0 cross-HoldCo. Concentration risk · cyber posture · talent benchmarks · compliance rollups. Triggered automatically as bundles land; refreshed quarterly with one-off ad-hoc spawns when concentration risk crosses thresholds.

Move 4 — Federated Risk + Governance

L0 Compliance Officer + HoldCo GCs consulted
  • Concentration risk dashboard — auditor, cyber carrier, banking partner, single-vendor exposures across HoldCos with trend.
  • CXO comp + IT FTE benchmarking — pulled from CIO/CFO/CHRO bundles, anchored against industry P50/P90.
  • Regulatory inventory roll-up — federated view of compliance frameworks each HoldCo lives under; gap detection for L0 IC reporting.
  • Cyber posture rollup — federated view of EDR, SIEM, IAM stack with concentration callouts.

Section 9 · The Tower L0 Federated Command Center

Atlas-fronted. New "Federated" tab on Tower. The L0 sponsor's daily-use surface. Pulls from all five Moves + every CXO bundle.

Top of page — portfolio rollup strip

Per HoldCo: active Moves · phase · value at stake · last update. Federated savings ledger (projected vs realized $). Concentration risk indicator (green/amber/red).

Cross-HoldCo opportunities surfaced this week

AbarVa proactively names new vendor overlaps detected, contract renewals approaching, capability-sharing matches, risk concentrations crossing thresholds. Each surfaces with "review" → routes to the relevant Move.

Federated savings ledger

Per Move per Source event: projected savings · realized to date · variance. Drill into per-vendor / per-category breakdown. Tied to corpus-cited benchmarks for credibility (no fake realized claims).

CXO performance dashboards

Per HoldCo CXO: IT spend % vs benchmark · AI maturity score · modernization debt index · talent comp vs P50/P90. L0 sees aggregate; HoldCo CXOs see their own with peer benchmark.

Risk concentration trend

Time series: auditor concentration · cyber carrier concentration · banking concentration · single-vendor concentration. Threshold crossings spawn Move 4 ad-hoc events.

Capability marketplace

Production AI workloads cataloged by HoldCo with metadata: business problem · model · data dependency · realized impact · reusability rating. HoldCo CIOs request fork.

Section 12 · State machine — cross-Move dependencies

Pre-Move
CXO bundles loaded (Wave 1 = CIO + CFO; Wave 2 = COO + CHRO + GC). At least Wave 1 must be complete for any HoldCo to enter Move 0 or Move 1.
Move 0 entry
Requires CFO bundle + banking inventory + Kyriba rollout status loaded. Triggers automatically when treasury workflow inventory + Kyriba status loaded for HoldCo with Kyriba "in flight" or "live not optimized" status.
Move 0 → Move 1
Move 1 entry requires Move 0 G1-G4 minimum green. G5-G6 in flight acceptable. This is the foundation-before-AI sequencing rule from the locked rules.
Move 2 entry
Requires CIO + CFO bundles loaded for ≥ 2 HoldCos. Triggers L0 cross-HoldCo joins automatically. Refreshed quarterly.
Move 3 entry
Requires CIO bundles for ≥ 2 HoldCos. Triggers AI marketplace + modernization wave coordinator. Refreshed quarterly with named operating review.
Move 4 entry
Auto-runs as soon as bundles land. Continuous. Ad-hoc events spawn when concentration risk crosses thresholds.
Source spawn
Source events spawn from Move architecture phases (Phase 3) when procurement is genuinely in scope. Source module redesign (`docs/build/source-design/`) handles the 11-stage lifecycle; Lakeshore Source events are the first real-world test of that redesign.
